'''2008 New York State Championship Nick Smarcz DS Agents Of Black Sun''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Nick Smarcz]] at [[2008 New York State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince|Ref2-D-agentsofblacksun.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Josie & the Pussycats
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS15]]
